results.question: Why does inhaled carbon monoxide reduce oxygen delivery to body tissues?
results.response: Inhaled carbon monoxide reduces oxygen delivery because hemoglobin binds CO more than 200 times more readily than it binds oxygen, forming carboxyhemoglobin (COHb). This blocks oxygen-binding sites on hemoglobin so fewer sites are available to carry oxygen, and the hemoglobin holds CO much more tightly, preventing oxygen release to the tissues.

results.question: Why does celiac disease cause nutritional deficiency, and what treatment stops the injury?
results.response:

The treatment that stops this injury is strict, lifelong avoidance of gluten-containing foods.
